name: 6amTech – Payment Gateway for bKash and WC
author: 6amtech

sections.description:
6amTech – Payment Gateway for bKash and WooCommerce is an essential solution for WooCommerce stores in Bangladesh. It lets you easily integrate bKash, the country’s leading mobile payment system, directly into your website.

This plugin provides your website’s customers with a smooth and secure checkout experience, making payments as effortless as possible. By adding this gateway, you’re not only offering a trusted and one of the most used e-commerce payment options but also improving the overall user experience. In general, it helps websites build trust and drive conversions.

Key Features:

  • Quick integration of bKash payment into WooCommerce checkout.
  • Secure and encrypted payment processing with bKash.
  • Supports both sandbox and live environments for testing.
  • Customize bKash payment method display names
  • Easy setup and configuration from WooCommerce settings.
  • No technical knowledge is required for installation and use.
  • Optimized for mobile payments and the Bangladesh e-commerce market.
  • Option to add payment charge as an additional fee.
  • Easy to validate the sandbox on the merchant panel with our payment response viewing feature.
  • Supports custom BDT pricing, even if your WooCommerce store operates in another currency.

Benefits:

  • Increase Sales: By offering bKash as a payment option, you will significantly increase the number of checkouts as bKash is already familiar to millions of users in Bangladesh.
  • Secure Transactions: With the bKash WooCommerce plugin, your customers’ payments are protected by the latest security measures, giving both you and your buyers peace of mind.
  • Mobile-friendly: This bKash plugin for WooCommerce is perfect for mobile e-commerce sites, with easy-to-use, responsive checkout.
  • Additional Revenue: You’re in control with the option to add payment charges as an additional fee to cover transaction costs and maintain profitability without affecting your margins.
  • Easy setup and management: This bKash WooCommerce plugin is designed with developers in mind. You’ll have it up and running in no time.
  • Multi-Currency Support: If the store’s default currency isn’t BDT, custom BDT prices can be set per product. bKash plugin will process the payment in BDT at checkout.

Documentation

Our bKash Payment Gateway for WooCommerce plugin includes detailed documentation to guide you through installation, setup, and configuration. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced developer, our step-by-step instructions ensure a smooth integration for your WooCommerce store.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Repository or upload it directly to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments, and enable bKash Payment Gateway.
  4. Configure the required settings, including bKash Merchant credentials, Sandbox mode, and more.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is free to download and use. You only need a valid bKash Merchant account to receive payments.

How secure is the bKash payment system?

bKash offers secure and encrypted payment processing, ensuring safe transactions for both store owners and customers.

Does it support sandbox/testing mode?

Yes, the plugin supports both live and sandbox modes for testing purposes.

Is the bKash merchant account necessary?

Yes, a bKash merchant account is necessary to use the bKash payment gateway for WooCommerce. You’ll need to create a merchant account with bKash before you can integrate the plugin into your store.

Is there any support or documentation available to assist me with any issues?

Yes, both support and documentation are available to assist you with any issues. While our support team is primarily focused on technical concerns, we provide detailed documentation to guide you through the integration and setup process. If you encounter any technical difficulties, feel free to reach out to our support team for assistance.
